title: Multiplayer, Accessibility, Performance & Golden Native-Tabletop Proof
objective: Prove the completed native tabletop experience under multiplayer, reconnect/rejoin, stale/conflict and GM-adjudication conditions; mobile/tablet, keyboard and nonvisual accessibility; large-map and animated-asset performance; audio-disabled operation; hidden-information protection; and deterministic authoritative results, culminating in a golden proof from legitimate asset/prepared Scene through live encounter, interactive region/object, audiovisual transition and post-Scene state without replacing any canonical owner authority.
preserved_boundaries: ISE-01..07 remained completed_verified with no reopened implementation authority.

Scene, World/Reality, Action/Event, Combat, Character, Creature, Item/Asset, Vehicle, permissions, MAI and AAI remained canonical; ISE-08 synchronization and proof receipts exercised but did not replace those authorities.

Remote clients could not promote local presentation, camera, token or accessibility state into canonical truth; duplicate requests were suppressed, stale state rejected and owner-version conflicts required GM adjudication.
Reconnect/rejoin failed closed and never silently overwrote newer authoritative state.
Hidden/GM-only information, protected cardinality and provider secrets were filtered before network, player, accessibility, diagnostic, export or AI projection.
Mobile/tablet, keyboard and nonvisual equivalents preserved consequential information/actions without making the visual canvas the sole authoritative representation.
Large maps, animated assets, degraded/missing media and audio-disabled operation preserved deterministic authoritative results and nonblocking play.
The five-stage golden proof preserved permission decisions, expected owner versions, deterministic idempotency and owner-domain validation while performing no canonical mutation by ISE-08.
No provider activation, commercial-media redistribution, credential embedding, entitlement inference, durable ISE-08 ledger or migration 0022 reservation was introduced.
SSA-01 remained unauthorized during ISE-08 implementation; tester distribution, release and deployment were not authorized.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: Initial application run 33267911618 failed client typecheck because the new composed proof render fixture omitted the inherited required tokens prop. After that changed-evidence fixture repair, run 33268026937 passed typecheck but the focused regression found two authorized sync fixtures sharing the same accessible button name. Raw artifact 9719239770 showed seven of eight tests passing and isolated the ambiguity; diagnostic mode was entered before the second test-only repair, which distinguished the stale fixture label without changing product behavior. Final exact head 34cf71ac1c2bb87f2929b120725ef8dfe9c4fe3e passed selector, Linux, Windows and deterministic comparison.
diagnostic_hypotheses: The first failure was feature_implementation/fixture typing at the composition seam, not a runtime authority defect: NativeGoldenTabletopProof correctly inherited the completed Scene stack's required tokens prop and the new render fixture omitted it.

The second failure was validation_contract-only: current and stale authorized synchronization fixtures intentionally reused one label, producing duplicate accessible button names; the product correctly rendered both and the singular test query was ambiguous.
No evidence indicated a synchronization, reconnect, accessibility, performance, golden-proof, hidden-state, provider or persistence contract defect.

retry_basis.evidence: Run 33268026937 Linux artifact 9719239770 preserved the raw focused-regression output after client typecheck passed. It showed exactly one failure: Testing Library found two buttons named 'Evaluate sync Player token projection' because current and stale authorized fixtures shared a label. Seven other ISE-08 tests passed, including sync outcomes, reconnect safety, accessibility filtering, performance proof, deterministic golden proof and deterministic receipts.
changed_since_previous: The first repair added tokens={[]} to the composed render fixture, directly resolving the TS2741 missing inherited prop signature from run 33267911618.

After raw artifact inspection and diagnostic-mode entry, the second repair changed only the stale fixture label to 'Stale player token projection', eliminating the accessible-name ambiguity while preserving both authorized controls and all production contracts.
The final validation ran on a new exact head and not on unchanged evidence; no predecessor profile was invoked.

next_action: ISE-08 and the ISE program are completed_verified and implementation authority is retired. SSA-01 is selected_not_started only; a future owner Continue is required before its governed start or product mutation.
